Hong Kong 🟡 Virtual Asset Services Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2026 gazetted 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261120-legco-5f9683f23a ⏰ Deadline: 2 December 2026 (first reading and House Committee consideration; legislative milestone, not a compliance deadline) Products: Investment, Digital LegCo’s bill record states that the Virtual Asset Services Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2026 was gazetted on 20 November 2026. The record schedules first reading and House Committee consideration for 2 December 2026. It does not record bill passage or Ordinance gazettal, and the retrieved record does not expose the operative bill or Legislative Council Brief content. This is a legislative-stage development rather than a current Hong Kong obligation; banks with investment or digital-asset activities may need to monitor confirmed scope, commencement and transition provisions when the underlying materials are available.
